same_image_no_device_attempts.failure: frozen SGLang is_npu() raises when torch_npu is installed and no device is visible
full qwen4_exp import loads a native extension that aborts without an NPU
ServerArgs calls torch.npu.mem_get_info() twice and aclInit fails with 507899 without a visible device

decision: Do not add a third fake-device shim. The no-device ServerArgs requirement was a locally imposed preflight design, not a user runtime requirement.
replacement_gate: Each admitted model process constructs real ServerArgs and verifies old-QSA/Qwen/PLE SHA identities on devices before run_server weight loading.
model_start_budget_effect: Attempts 1-3 loaded no model and consumed zero generations; v180-v183 are the four budgeted starts.
